headline: DEATH ROW 💉 QUEEN Christa Pike SURVIVES 2 LETHAL JABS 🩸
text:
TENNESSEE 🏥 DEATH row inmate Christa Pike 🚨 got RUSHED 🏃‍♀️ to the hospital 🏥 after her HEART 💓 kept BEATING 🥁 following TWO 💉 lethal injections 🧪 of pentobarbital 💊 during her botched execution 😵!! Her lawyer 🧑‍⚖️ says the 50-year-old 👵 is now being given LIFE-SAVING 🛟 measures after TWO 💉 syringes failed to finish the job 🪦, leaving her SNORING 😴 out loud while still conscious enough to trigger an emergency motion 📜!! The whole thing went down at Riverbend Maximum Security Institution 🏢 in Nashville 🌃 around 8pm 🕗 Wednesday night 🌙 with the curtain in the witness room getting YANKED shut 🪟 twice while media folks 📺 were asked to LEAVE 🚪 the scene!! "Ms Pike has lost consciousness 😶 and still has a heartbeat 💗 and is audibly snoring 😮‍💨" her legal team screamed in the filing as they begged for a halt 🛑!!

PIKE'S ⚖️ ATTORNEYS dropped an emergency motion mid-execution 🛑 claiming difficult vein access 🩸, blown veins 💥, degraded pentobarbital 🧪 and zero emergency medical care 🩺 available when it all went sideways under a secret protocol 🤫!! They told the Tennessean 📰 "Tonight the State of Tennessee once again FAILED ❌ to carry out a lawful execution" with no pleasure in being right but every concern she raised proved TRUE ✅!! One attorney whispered to the BBC 📻 that Pike is currently receiving life-saving measures 🏥 in hospital after the double dose of pentobarbital never quite hit the bloodstream hard enough to stop her heart 💓!! Dr Joel Zivot 🧑‍⚕️ an expert kept on retainer by her team warned she likely never reached sufficient blood levels of the drug 💉 to cause apnea or cardiovascular collapse and now faces possible brain injury 🧠 from the delayed resuscitation!! The Tennessee Department of Correction 🛡️ swears they followed every single step of the approved protocol 📋 and the chemical has always worked before so they transported her off-site anyway 🚑!!

THIS EXECUTION 🔥 only happened after the US Supreme Court 🏛️ overturned a lower court's reprieve earlier that Wednesday morning 🌅 marking the SECOND ⏳ time in two days the justices gave the green light 🚦 for Pike's lethal injection 🪦!! Earlier the US Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit had paused everything ⏸️ saying they needed more time to chew on her arguments about mitigating evidence 📜!! Her lawyers argued the original 1996 jury never got to weigh her documented childhood sexual abuse 🛡️ history before sentencing her to death for the murder of 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer 🪦!! For years Tennessee had called her a liar about the abuse but suddenly at a recent hearing they admitted they no longer disputed the sexual abuse and rape claims 😳!! Tennessee's governor still denied her clemency request this week even though she's the only woman on the state's death row 👩‍⚖️!!

BACK IN 1995 🗓️ an 18-year-old Pike and her then-boyfriend Tadaryl Shipp 🧔 beat tortured and killed Colleen Slemmer whom they met at a job training camp for troubled teens 🏕️!! In her clemency petition Pike said she only meant to beat her not kill her but couldn't "put the brakes on" 🚗 and described herself as a mentally ill kid who took years to grasp the gravity of stealing someone's child sister and friend 👧!! The murder sparked a Knoxville media frenzy after Colleen was found with an inverted pentagram 🕉️ carved into her chest though Pike denies doing the carving herself 🖐️!! Two other camp residents testified she bragged about the murder before and after and even showed off a piece of Colleen's skull 💀!! Colleen's mom May Martinez 👩‍🍼 said she waited decades for this and still thinks every day about her daughter feeling that pain trying to run away 🏃‍♀️ while holidays destroy her 😢!!

ONLY 18 women have been executed in the US since 1976 compared to 1,663 men making it roughly one percent of all executions 📉!! Pike was sentenced to death in 1996 for the murder and her legal team fought hard claiming she was a victim of her own past too 🥀 yet the state stood by every action taken during the attempted execution saying the protocol remains lawful and effective 💉!! The judge ended up ordering medical care be given as requested in that frantic motion while Pike lies in a hospital bed clinging on after two failed syringes of pentobarbital that never quite cooked the job 🧪!! Her lawyers keep stressing they take no joy in being proven right about the flawed process that left her heart still thumping and her body snoring through the nightmare 😴!!
